svg.text: VISION-ASSISTED PROSTHETIC ARM (VAPA) — SYSTEM WIRING HARNESS (REV 2)
Drawing: VAPA-ELEC-001 | Architecture: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano + ESP32 Safety Supervisor + Dual 6V Servo Rails | Scale: Schematic
Turn-off Time < 35 us upon E-stop button depression
2. MAIN COMPUTING: NVIDIA JETSON ORIN NANO
Pins 2, 4: +5.0V Input (from Logic Buck via AWG 20)
Pins 3, 5: I2C-7 (400 kHz Fast-Mode) | Pins 8, 10: UART1 (460.8 kbps)
Physical Link: USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type-C with locking thumb screws
Data Streams: 640x480 Depth @ 30 FPS + 1280x720 RGB @ 30 FPS
Power Draw: 5V @ 700mA supplied via Jetson internal USB VBUS
Fail-Safe: Control loop never blocks on vision; 250ms freshness expiry
• 100 Hz Main Control Loop with perf_counter jitter monitor
• 50 Hz Dedicated Heartbeat Thread (trips if loop stalls > 40ms)
• Shared-Control Arbitration: EMG = Intent, Vision = Context Only
• Non-Negotiable: Vision can NEVER initiate or increase closing motion
GPIO 25: PCA9685 /OE (Active LOW; 10k pull-up; Boots HIGH)
GPIO 27: E-Stop Input (Optocoupled; active LOW triggers OE drop)
GPIO 16/17: UART2 RX2/TX2 (460.8 kbps to Jetson Orin Nano)
GPIO 21/22: I2C Master to ISO1540 (Isolated ADS1115 sampling)
Power: 3.3V from dedicated AP2112K LDO (600mA, <250mV dropout)
Watchdog: Hardware Task WDT set to 350 ms timeout
1. System Boots strictly DISARMED (/OE held HIGH).
2. Arming requires explicit Jetson 0->1 arm transition + safe status.
3. Heartbeat loss (>250ms) latches fault and drops /OE immediately.
4. E-stop strike drops /OE instantly in <100us hardware interrupt.
5. Force ceiling >3500 ADC counts (>100ms warning, >500ms latch fault).
6. Non-blocking ADS1115 sampling at 860 SPS (A0, A1, A2 cycling).
7. Fast CRC16-CCITT-FALSE 256-entry lookup table for all UART frames.
8. I2C Bus Auto-Recovery: 9 SCL clock pulses on bus lockup.
Jetson CANNOT override ESP32 supervisor hardware shutdown.
I2C Address: 0x40 (A0-A5 to GND) | Frequency: 50 Hz
ALLCALL Mode Disabled (MODE1 bit 0 = 0 to avoid 0x70 clash)
Output Enable (/OE, Pin 23): Pulled to 3.3V, driven by ESP32 GPIO25
Dual 2200uF 16V Low-ESR Decoupling Caps across 6V Terminals
5. SENSOR FEEDBACK: TCA9548A I2C MUX + 4x AS5600 ENCODERS + 5x FSR402 SENSORS
Address Strapping: A0 to 3.3V (0x71) prevents PCA9685 clash
Cabling: 4-Pin JST-SH (3.3V, GND, SCL, SDA) with shield
Magnets: Diametric N52 Neodymium Discs (6x2.5mm, Air Gap 1.0mm)
Tracking: Closed-loop stall detector trips fault if pos err > 12 deg for > 350ms
Uncommanded Motion: Trips fault if velocity > 20 deg/s while held
Sensing Area: 0.5" round film on distal fingertips (Thumb to Little)
• Circuit: 5x Precision Voltage Dividers with 10.0k 0.1% 25ppm pull-downs
• Low-Pass Filter: 0.1 uF ceramic caps across pull-downs (fc = 318 Hz)
• ESD Clamping: SP3002 TVS array clamps line to 3.3V rail (+/-15kV air)
Calibration: Piecewise monotonic interpolation from config/fsr.yaml
- ADC < 10: Open-circuit / disconnected wire detected -> Trips FAULT
- ADC >= 4090: Short-circuit to 3.3V / crushed sensor -> Trips FAULT
- Force Ceiling: Real-time backoff if measured force > 350 grams
6. BIOMEDICAL ISOLATION BARRIER & MYOWARE 2.0 EMG INTERFACE (IEC 60601-1 TYPE BF)
Patient Skin Contact: Forearm Snap Electrodes (Ag/AgCl Gel Electrodes)
Channel A0: MyoWare #1 Envelope (Flexor Carpi Radialis) -> Hand Close Intent
Channel A1: MyoWare #2 Envelope (Extensor Digitorum) -> Hand Open Intent
Channel A2: Auxiliary EEG / Cranial Electrode Input (Reserved)
Channel A3: Isolated Chassis Reference & Baseline Offset Monitor
1. ZERO physical copper/conductive path to 12V battery or noisy servo grounds.
2. Patient Leakage Current < 2 uA (well below IEC 60601-1 100 uA limit).
3. Rapid Extensor Open Override: Extensor spike triggers instant open in < 5 ms.
4. Stuck / Saturated Signal Detection: Baseline < 200mV or > 3000mV flags fault.

g.text: Rate: 100 Hz SENSOR packets, 2 Hz STATUS
SCL/SDA twisted with GND; Shield single-grounded
• Active LOW: Tristates all 16 PWM channels
• Drops OE on: E-stop, HB timeout (250ms), fault
Independent of Jetson OS state or crash
• Cable shield grounded at TCA9548A ONLY
Latency: 0.82 ms total scan time across 4 joints
• GND_POWER: 15A returns from Rail A & B
• Single Star Point at battery negative shunt
